
---
title: "Phosphoproteomics – Prepared DEA comparison"
subtitle: "BIO253 HS2026 · Topic 1 · S. aureus JE2"
format: html
---

## 1. Research question

Does *S. aureus* JE2 show significant phosphorylation changes after 15 minutes of *P. aeruginosa* supernatant exposure, and how does this compare with approximately 15 hours of exposure?

This analysis uses the course-provided differential expression results to allow a more consistent comparison with the total-proteomics analysis.

## 2. Setup and data

```{r}
#| label: setup

source("../../R/setup.R")

dea_phospho <- read_dea("phospho_STYH")

dplyr::glimpse(dea_phospho)
```

## 3. Explore the prepared DEA results

We first examine the two estimate types in the course-provided
phosphoproteomics DEA. The `observed` results and the
`lod_imputed` results will be evaluated separately.

```{r}
#| label: estimate-types

dea_phospho |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(contrast, estimate_type)
```

## 4. Significant phosphosites in the prepared DEA

We define a significant change as FDR < 0.05 and an absolute
log2 fold change greater than 1, matching the thresholds used
in the total-proteomics analysis.

The observed and imputed estimates are summarised separately.

```{r}
#| label: significant-sites

phospho_summary <- dea_phospho |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    changed = !is.na(FDR) &
              !is.na(diff) &
              FDR < 0.05 &
              abs(diff) > 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(contrast, estimate_type) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_rows = dplyr::n(),
    sites_tested = sum(!is.na(FDR) & !is.na(diff)),
    significant_sites = sum(changed),
    percent_significant = dplyr::if_else(
      sites_tested > 0,
      round(100 * significant_sites / sites_tested, 2),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

phospho_summary
```

## 5. Replicate reliability of observed phosphosites

To make the analysis more comparable with the total-proteomics
analysis, we require phosphosites to be detected in at least
2 of 3 biological replicates in both compared conditions.

```{r}
#| label: observed-reliability

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

sites_raw <- read_sites("STYH")

# Count observed replicates for each phosphosite and medium
n_obs_phospho <- sites_raw |>
  filter(genotype == "anc") |>
  group_by(site_id, medium) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(log2_intensity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = medium,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Join replicate counts to the observed DEA results
dea_observed <- dea_phospho |>
  filter(
    estimate_type == "observed",
    contrast %in% c(
      "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
      "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc"
    )
  ) |>
  left_join(n_obs_phospho, by = "site_id") |>
  mutate(
    reliable = case_when(
      contrast == "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc" ~
        TSB >= 2 & SNpulse >= 2,
      contrast == "TSB_vs_SN_at_anc" ~
        TSB >= 2 & SN >= 2
    ),
    changed = !is.na(FDR) &
              !is.na(diff) &
              FDR < 0.05 &
              abs(diff) > 1
  )

# Summarise only reliably measured phosphosites
observed_reliable_summary <- dea_observed |>
  filter(reliable %in% TRUE) |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  summarise(
    sites_tested = n(),
    significant_sites = sum(changed),
    percent_significant = round(
      100 * significant_sites / sites_tested, 2
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

observed_reliable_summary
```


## 6. Exploratory phosphosite detection without the 2/3 filter

To investigate potentially relevant phosphorylation events that
may have been missed by the replicate reliability filter, we
examine all phosphosites detected in wild-type S. aureus JE2
under TSB and SNpulse conditions.

This analysis includes phosphosites detected in only one
biological replicate. Missing intensity values are interpreted
as non-detections, not as evidence of absent phosphorylation.

```{r}
#| label: exploratory-detection

site_detection <- sites_raw |>
  dplyr::filter(
    genotype == "anc",
    medium %in% c("TSB", "SNpulse")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(site_id, medium) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_detected = sum(!is.na(log2_intensity)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = medium,
    values_from = n_detected,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    TSB = tidyr::replace_na(TSB, 0L),
    SNpulse = tidyr::replace_na(SNpulse, 0L)
  )

# Detection patterns across the two conditions
detection_patterns <- site_detection |>
  dplyr::count(TSB, SNpulse, name = "n_sites") |>
  dplyr::arrange(TSB, SNpulse)

knitr::kable(detection_patterns)
```

### 6.1 Summary of detection patterns

We distinguish sites detected exclusively in one condition,
sites detected in both conditions, and sites not detected
in either condition.

```{r}
#| label: detection-summary

detection_summary <- site_detection |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_sites = dplyr::n(),
    detected_any = sum(TSB > 0 | SNpulse > 0),
    TSB_only = sum(TSB > 0 & SNpulse == 0),
    SNpulse_only = sum(TSB == 0 & SNpulse > 0),
    detected_both = sum(TSB > 0 & SNpulse > 0),
    detected_neither = sum(TSB == 0 & SNpulse == 0),
    reliable_both = sum(TSB >= 2 & SNpulse >= 2)
  )

knitr::kable(detection_summary)
```

## 7. Statistical comparison with and without the 2/3 filter

We compare the course-provided observed DEA results before
and after applying the additional replicate reliability filter.

Significance is defined as FDR < 0.05 and absolute log2 fold
change > 1.

Removing the filter does not change any filtering already
performed in the course-provided DEA pipeline.

```{r}
#| label: filter-comparison

filter_comparison <- dea_observed |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast == "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    valid_estimate = !is.na(FDR) & !is.na(diff),
    significant = valid_estimate &
      FDR < 0.05 & abs(diff) > 1
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    valid_without_filter = sum(valid_estimate),
    significant_without_filter = sum(significant),
    valid_with_filter = sum(
      valid_estimate & reliable %in% TRUE
    ),
    significant_with_filter = sum(
      significant & reliable %in% TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    additional_valid_sites =
      valid_without_filter - valid_with_filter,
    additional_significant_sites =
      significant_without_filter - significant_with_filter
  )

knitr::kable(filter_comparison)
```

## 8. Additional phosphosites for exploratory investigation

We identify phosphosites with valid observed DEA estimates
that do not pass the 2/3 replicate reliability filter.

These sites are potential candidates for further investigation,
but should not automatically be considered significantly changed.

```{r}
#| label: additional-candidates

additional_candidates <- dea_observed |>
  dplyr::filter(
    contrast == "TSB_vs_SNpulse_at_anc",
    reliable %in% FALSE,
    !is.na(FDR),
    !is.na(diff)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    site_id,
    staa8_gene,
    product,
    diff,
    FDR,
    TSB,
    SNpulse
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(FDR, dplyr::desc(abs(diff)))

cat("Additional candidate rows:", nrow(additional_candidates), "\n")
cat("Expected additional sites:", filter_comparison$additional_valid_sites, "\n")

knitr::kable(
  additional_candidates,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Additional phosphosites excluded by the 2/3 filter"
)
```

### 8.1 Phosphosites detected only after 15 minutes

We additionally identify phosphosites detected in SNpulse
but not in TSB, including sites with only one detected
replicate.

These are exploratory detection candidates rather than
confirmed phosphorylation changes.

```{r}
#| label: snpulse-only-candidates

snpulse_only_candidates <- site_detection |>
  dplyr::filter(
    TSB == 0,
    SNpulse > 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(SNpulse),
    site_id
  )

# Summary by number of detected SNpulse replicates
snpulse_only_candidates |>
  dplyr::count(SNpulse, name = "n_sites") |>
  knitr::kable()

# Show candidates detected in at least 2 SNpulse replicates
snpulse_only_candidates |>
  dplyr::filter(SNpulse >= 2) |>
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "SNpulse-only sites detected in at least 2 replicates"
  )
```


## 9. Conclusion

Removing the additional 2/3 replicate reliability filter increased the
number of phosphosites with valid observed DEA estimates in the
15-minute TSB versus SNpulse comparison from 122 to 170. The number
of significant phosphosites remained three (FDR < 0.05 and
absolute log2 fold change > 1).

In the raw detection analysis, 366 phosphosites were detected in
SNpulse but not in TSB. Of these, 31 were detected in at least two
SNpulse replicates, including seven detected in all three. These
are exploratory detection candidates, not confirmed differential
phosphorylation events. Changes in phosphopeptide intensity may also
reflect differences in total protein abundance.

The candidates can be compared with Simona's total-proteomics
results to help prioritize biological follow-up.
